title: Model Catalog: lineage badges, deprecation timeline, and tiered pricing quickstart visuals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding and release-note visual assets for the Model Catalog update that introduces lineage badges, a visual deprecation timeline, and tiered pricing callouts. Deliverables include desktop and mobile screenshots for the Quickstart flow, updated release note hero image, deprecation banner variations, and a compact pricing badge pack for use in docs and emails.
acceptance_criteria: All listed assets exported at 2x desktop and 3x mobile PNGs and an SVG pack for badges
Screenshots use production catalog data or mocked entries matching new naming conventions
Deprecation timeline has ARIA-friendly alt text and two contrast-checked color variants
Pricing badges match console type tokens and scale to 40px/24px usages
Design handoff notes uploaded to Drive and linked in PR description
PM sign-off on microcopy and legal-approved deprecation language
updates: 2026-03-01: Ticket created after PM sync; scope confirmed to include both onboarding quickstart and release note hero.
2026-03-03: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma; decision to represent deprecation as a timeline rather than modal confirmed (see Figma frame: Timeline-v1).
2026-03-05: Engineering review (ENG-3210) requested constraints for in-console screenshots (tile dimensions and max badge count = 3).
2026-03-07: Updated color variants produced for accessibility review; contrast report attached to Drive.
2026-03-09: PM feedback: change 'Sunset' microcopy to 'Deprecated — Read migration guide' and add link placeholder. Implemented in all mockups.
2026-03-10: Prepared handoff ZIP and draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2789 (assets added under /static/catalog/releases/2026-03)
Follow-up: Add localized screenshots for fr-FR and deprecation copy variants in Cycle 2026-W12 if Analytics shows >5% EU adoption per model.
notes: Avoid using exact pricing numbers in screenshots — use tier labels (Free / Professional / Enterprise) and relative cost callouts.
Lineage badges should have hover state copy: 'Forked from model-x \u2014 modified tokenizer'. Include a tooltip spec in handoff.
Deprecation timeline needs an automated variant where 'Deprecated' toggles to 'Sunset scheduled' for timelines on release notes.
Prepare a compact badge set for email clients (PNG fallbacks) and an SVG set for web console.
Coordinate with i18n for string length allowances in mobile screenshots to avoid truncation.
